style.styleTitle: Charles Bentley Pre-lit Eucalyptus Wreath & Christmas Garland Set
style.toneOfVoice: A softer, more botanical take on festive foliage. The 55cm eucalyptus wreath has a light snowy dusting, white berries, and pinecones, and 50 warm white micro LEDs woven through the frosted greenery. It s happy on a front door or in a sheltered porch. Inside, the 180cm garland brings a full run of realistic green foliage with 133 branch tips and another 50 warm white LEDs. Both pieces run on batteries, so you are not tied to a socket, and both just need their branches fanning out by hand. The wreath is suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use. The garland is best kept indoors or in a protected area. No hanging hook is supplied with the wreath. Batteries aren t included – you ll need three AA for each piece. Branches need fanning out by hand to look their best. Dimensions(mm): Height: 550 Width: 1800 Depth: 550.
